_about: Stat weights per class.spec. 'leveling' is used below level 60, 'endgame' at 60. Values are equivalence points in the role's main unit (AP, spell power, +healing or Stamina). Weapons: 'dps' points per weapon DPS (main hand / two-hander), 'offhand_dps' for dual wield, 'ranged_dps' for hunters, 'slow_bonus' points per second of weapon speed above 2.5. Sources are listed per profile; tune values here and re-run scripts/data/build_gear.py.

weapon.note: In Cat Form weapon damage does not count; only the weapon's stats and feral attack power.

sources: Patch 1.12 formulas: Warrior/Paladin/Shaman/Druid-cat 1 Str = 2 AP; Rogue 1 Agi = 1 AP and 1 Str = 1 AP; Hunter 1 Agi = 2 ranged AP; ~20 Agi = 1% melee crit (Rogue ~29, Hunter ~53); 1% crit ~ 20-30 AP; 1% hit ~ 15-20 AP up to the hit cap.
